in_sanskrit.name: अм्बिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अम् (Amb-) meaning no, not + बिक (Bika) meaning mother, hence, Ambika means the mother who gives or provides everything, without any denial or negation.

in_hindi.name: अм्बिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: माता (Mata) meaning mother + का (Ka) meaning having, hence, Ambika means the mother who has or possesses everything.

in_tamil.name: அம்பிகை
in_tamil.long_meaning: அம் (Am) meaning not + பிகை (Pigai) meaning mother, hence, Ambika means the mother who is free from any negation or denial.
